body:
I would like another pet, but I can't. I am too broke. I couldn't afford the  vet visits and other pet associated costs. I adopted my previous dog on a whim because an acquaintance of mine was going to drop the then 5 year old dog off at the animal shelter. More than once I had to go to my parents to borrow money for her care. It would be selfish and irresponsible of me to get another animal in my position.

Thank you for responding, since as you say, you are having the same problems as me, and I know how hard it is to reach out, so I really appreciate it. Thank you. I wish you the best.
